reportability_rule: Development execution may report the landmark population, Kaplan-Meier curves, adjusted hazard ratio, confidence interval, and PH audit only as analysis_only while human scientific attestation is pending. A PH violation blocks paper authorization, and all text must preserve the observational, source-specific exposure boundary.
forbidden_interpretations: Do not interpret the hazard ratio as the causal effect of mechanical ventilation.
Do not call ventilation first observed at ICU hour 0 an incident exposure.
Do not treat an absent death date as unknown follow-up in MIMIC-IV v3.1 within the documented one-year censoring window.
Do not generalize the first-observed procedure timestamp to pre-ICU ventilation history.
Do not describe the 0-24-hour SOFA-2 adjustment as purely pre-exposure baseline confounding control.
